title: Total selected downtime 2
scenario: A fictitious rolling line logs downtime by shift and cause. Each event is independent; repeated shift and cause values are expected. All records and limits are fictitious training assumptions.

lesson.intro: SUMIFS adds a numeric column only where every criterion matches the same row. Keep sum and criteria ranges aligned. Do not add two separate conditional totals for an AND rule. Separate miniature example: A2:A4 contains Day, Night, Day; B2:B4 contains 4, 7, 3.

formulas.name: SUMIFS
formulas.explanation: sum_range contains amounts. Each criteria_range aligns with it; the following criterion defines which rows qualify. Additional pairs are optional.

task.prompt: Total Downtime_min for Shift = Day AND Cause = Repair. Keep every qualifying record, including repeated categories. Ignore blank amounts and retain zero. Return the exact integer total, without rounding. Return one numeric value in Answers!B2. Use an Excel formula; any equivalent approach is accepted. Submit the formula and the complete output.

columns.name: Downtime_min
columns.description: Minutes. Blank contributes no numeric amount; numeric zero contributes zero.
